description: This file is a code-behind for a web form in an ASP.NET application. It manages user profile display, including retrieving user details from a SQL database upon page load, and handling navigation buttons like home, leaderboard, and logout. The code interacts with session variables and database commands, indicating core functionality related to user profile management within an online examination system.
